what: Ticket text, filed as a row because this cloud session has no tracker. Title: @kalfa/quality/stryker: the plant runner on Stryker (0600), and libfabrika's laws in the hourly mutation run. Let the hourly mutation run pick kind-sibling tests and pass CI's marker into its container, so libfabrika's laws, integration laws included, run there.
